booking_duration_bounds.name: booking_duration_bounds
booking_duration_bounds.value: "booking"."kind" <> 'hourly' or "booking"."ends_at" - "booking"."starts_at" between interval '15 minutes' and interval '10 hours'

booking_pass_complete.name: booking_pass_complete
booking_pass_complete.value: "booking"."kind" = 'hourly' or ("booking"."space_id" is not null and "booking"."pass" is not null and "booking"."slot" is not null and "booking"."start_date" is not null and "booking"."end_date" is not null and "booking"."price" is not null and "booking"."currency" is not null)

booking_pass_length.name: booking_pass_length
booking_pass_length.value: "booking"."kind" = 'hourly' or "booking"."end_date" - "booking"."start_date" = case "booking"."pass" when 'day' then 0 when 'week' then 6 else 29 end

seat_hold_booking_bounded.name: seat_hold_booking_bounded
seat_hold_booking_bounded.value: "seat_hold"."booking_id" is null or ("seat_hold"."ends_at" is not null and "seat_hold"."service_date" is not null)

space_opening_hours_valid.name: space_opening_hours_valid
space_opening_hours_valid.value: "space"."opening_mode" IS NULL OR ("space"."opening_mode" = 'always_open' AND "space"."shift_change_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("space"."opening_mode" = 'fixed_hours' AND "space"."opens_at" IS NOT NULL AND "space"."closes_at" IS NOT NULL AND "space"."closes_at" > "space"."opens_at")

space_owned_complete.name: space_owned_complete
space_owned_complete.value: "space"."owner_id" IS NULL OR ("space"."description" IS NOT NULL AND "space"."country" IS NOT NULL AND "space"."city" IS NOT NULL AND "space"."area" IS NOT NULL AND "space"."street_address" IS NOT NULL AND "space"."currency" IS NOT NULL AND "space"."opening_mode" IS NOT NULL)

layout_element_kind_ref.name: layout_element_kind_ref
layout_element_kind_ref.value: ("layout_element"."kind" = 'seat') = ("layout_element"."seat_id" IS NOT NULL) AND ("layout_element"."kind" = 'cubicle') = ("layout_element"."cubicle_id" IS NOT NULL) AND ("layout_element"."kind" = 'area') = ("layout_element"."label" IS NOT NULL)

layout_element_label_length.name: layout_element_label_length
layout_element_label_length.value: "layout_element"."label" IS NULL OR length(btrim("layout_element"."label")) between 1 and 40
